title: Historic East Nash Charmer, 10 Min to Downtown
description:
Fall in love with this ~90-year-old East Nashville bungalow, where original hardwood floors, French doors, and our guest-favorite green 'Nashville' wall meet a fresh kitchen and cozy beds. Sip coffee on the porch swing, grill in the fenced backyard, then reach Downtown in about 10 minutes. Sleeps 8 across 4 bedrooms (2 Kings, 1 Queen, 2 Singles) with 3 baths, full kitchen, Wi‑Fi/workspace, laundry, free parking, and easy self check‑in.

The space
The space

Welcome to your East Nashville home base—a ~90-year-old historic bungalow with the charm you want (hardwood floors + French doors) and the updates you need (fresh kitchen, comfy beds, and a clean modern bath).

*What guests love

 - Historic character: original wood floors + classic French doors

 - Outdoor living: front porch swing + large back deck for relaxing

 - Bright, updated kitchen: plenty of counter space and cabinet storage

 - Comfortable sleeping: spacious bedrooms with cozy linens

 - Photo-friendly touches: the green “Nashville” wall is a guest favorite

*Layout (quick and clear)

 - Main level: entry/living + dining + kitchen + 2 bedrooms

 - Second level: 2 bedrooms + 1 bathroom

 - Outdoor: front porch + large back deck

*Location

You’re in Cleveland Park (East Nashville)—a favorite neighborhood for visitors who want quick access to Downtown while staying in a local, residential area. Downtown, restaurants, and coffee shops are about 10 minutes away by car, depending on traffic.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire main house and the back deck.

Other things to note
There is a detached back house/ADU on the property with its own tenants. The enclosed gazebo and the detached unit are not part of the guest space.
